title: No BG values are displayed when Dexcom app shows "low"
body:
I went hypo a few days ago (June 9th, just aroung 1:00 am). So low, that the Dexcom app was only displaying "low". But was still receiving readings, so the sensor was connected all the time. ![Screenshot_20230609-014229_1](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/68594202/e78ef415-14d8-4c41-91b5-cac15b22988d) However, during the time of "low" my AAPS was not displaying any values from the Dexcom app. You can tell by the pale-red dots in the overview, that the values are recalculated. ![Screenshot_20230609-014222_1](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/68594202/3c3d92dd-d5e3-4169-8837-cfcb4c908bc5) The BYODA-tab also shows no readings from Dexcom during the period 1:16 to 1:36. ![Screenshot_20230609-014217_1](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/68594202/3ce50d0a-1aff-4685-ac73-a121e57e5587) As soon as my levels started to rise and Dexcom was displaying an actual value, rather than "low", AAPS also picked up a value and was displaying as normal. As far as I understand this extract from the logs, the value was received in AAPS, but still not displayed. The logs also state, that the value was submitted to Nightscout, but it also can't be seen there. I have the same gap in Nightscout, that I have in AAPS.

Luckily, I wasn't that low very often but when I was, I still had readings in AAPS (40 or sometimes even below).
